description: This file contains transformer functions for schedule data, including converting availability and working hours into formats suitable for Atom components, handling date overrides, and mapping schedule availability to daily time slots.

methods.name: transformWorkingHoursForAtom
methods.description: Transforms schedule's working hours into a format suitable for Atom, considering timezone and availability.

methods.name: transformAvailabilityForAtom
methods.description: Converts schedule availability into a structured format with adjusted end times.

methods.name: transformDateOverridesForAtom
methods.description: Processes date overrides in schedule, filtering future dates and organizing them by day.

methods.name: transformScheduleToAvailabilityForAtom
methods.description: Maps schedule availability into daily time slots with UTC dates.
